messages.text: ok I did it. ordered the Wacom Cintiq. it arrives Thursday
$800. blew my February budget but it'll last years
you needed it. those little Intuos tablets were holding you back
exactly. the Cintiq is a completely different workflow. I can actually see what I'm drawing
what are you up to tonight?
soldering a sensor array onto an Arduino for a new ambient-sound piece — I want it to react to sound levels and shift the color palette
that is the most Alicia sentence I have ever read
😂 I have three Raspberry Pis and two Arduinos at various stages of project. the studio is a fire hazard
How's the ankle? You good for Saturday?
About 90%. PT said I can hike if I tape it and keep it flat. Upper Park should be fine.
Smart. Remember when you rolled it on that root last spring? That looked brutal.
Exactly that one. Six weeks of PT. Good times.
como te fue con los gastos de diciembre? te quedaste sin plata? 😂
SIEMPRE lol. between the Sacramento trip for Christmas, all the gifts, the care package I send abuela in Medellin, and some year-end donations... December is just brutal every year
el paquete para abuela te costo mucho este año?
like $80 to ship plus what's inside. but it's worth it. I budget for it separately now
Hey it's been like 7 weeks since the kids have seen you. They're asking. Weekend in March?
Yes please. March 14-15? They can have the couch. Maya will want to do studio time.
She's been drawing narwhals for two weeks straight btw.
Lol perfect. Tell her Tia Ali will have supplies ready. Every 6-8 weeks feels right yeah.
did you take any real time off last year?
two weeks total — one for the wisdom tooth thing in July, one proper vacation around the holidays. so about 50 working weeks out of 52
that's not a lot of vacation
I know. I keep saying I'll use more PTO but the research calendar doesn't really pause
What are you cooking tonight for Tuesday?
Trying the quinoa empanadas again — last time the dough kept cracking. Also making arepas with the aji amarillo pork. I want to teach you the pork rub.
Yes please. I'll be doing sambar on my end, we can trade off.
Perfect. Also I might do chimichurri plantains if I have time — my mom's version.
Hey, did you ever get that receipt sorted for your taxes? You mentioned waiting on something from December.
Yeah finally! RAICES sent theirs last week. Still waiting on World Central Kitchen but I only need one for the itemized stuff
Smart to do it before the deadline chaos. I always forget something.
Same ones as usual for me, late December tradition at this point. Makes the paperwork predictable at least
Speaking of predictable — sambar recipe is happening tonight. You ready for arepas next week?
Already got the masarepa. Tuesday is locked in 🫓
finished Story of Your Life last night — you were so right
RIGHT?? Chiang does something no one else does with time and language. I've read that collection three times
what should I read next from him
Exhalation, no question. Also if you haven't read Ursula Le Guin's The Dispossessed, that's next on my list to reread
Mija, tu papá tiene cita con el cardiólogo el viernes a las 2
Says he doesn't need me to come but you know how he is 🙄
Can you remind him to bring the log he's been keeping? Dr. Muñoz wanted to see his numbers from the last month
Ya se lo dije! He's been good about checking every morning since that scare
Two years and he still won't admit he was scared 😂
As long as he's taking everything on time. The refills are automatic now right?
Sí, CVS sends them every 90 days. I set up the auto-refill myself because you KNOW he would forget
Maya says she misses Tia Ali. When are you coming to SJ?
Luca just figured out how to open the fridge. Send help.
He's three and already working on fridge access? Future engineer. Give Priya and the kids a hug from me.
Will do. Priya says hi — her Priya, not your Priya 😂
Did you see that thread everyone's sharing about the new diffusion paper? It's blowing up on Twitter
I didn't, I'm still off that whole thing. Can you just send me the paper link directly?
Oh right I keep forgetting you deleted it. One sec
Perfect, thank you. I'll read it tonight and we can discuss Tuesday
Honestly I respect the commitment. I waste like an hour scrolling every morning before I even get out of bed
It's been almost eight months now. My mornings are genuinely different
Hey how'd the grant deadline go
Lol classic. You and the wire
I know I know. I had it mostly done but then I got into this rabbit hole about this new diffusion architecture and rewrote half of section 3
Couldn't resist exploring. It's way more interesting now though
You're going to give yourself a heart attack one of these days. Remember the senior thesis?
That was different I had actual insomnia then
This time I was just vibing and lost track. I work better under pressure anyway
Sure you do. Maya wants to know if you'll paint a whale shark next time btw
Ok so I finally started Sing, Unburied, Sing like you kept telling me to
I'm only 60 pages in and already destroyed
YESSS I'm so glad you started it
Jesmyn Ward does something with grief that I've never seen anyone else do
It's so different from the Coates you had me read last year. More lyrical?
Yeah totally. Between the World and Me hit me more like a punch. This is more like drowning slowly. In a good way??
You really have become my entire reading committee since 2020 lol
I just had a lot of catching up to do. These were authors I'd skipped for too long
what's your neighborhood actually like? I keep forgetting to ask
super chill. lots of old bungalows, student rentals scattered around. they say Chico has more trees than people and I believe it
Bidwell Park is literally a 10-minute walk from my door which is the whole reason I picked this block
it is. very quiet street. a few undergrads next building over but they're fine
parcera did u see apartments are going for like $1100 now with roommates in oakland 😭 I could save SO much
but like. no. I cant. not again
oh I know. I could be putting away like $600 more a month if I got a roommate
but after everything with Daniel I just... needed my own space. like NEEDED it
no te culpo prima. I get it. after Miami I would have paid literally anything for my own door to close
exactly. the quiet. being able to just exist without negotiating anything
que nota. our therapists would be proud lol
haha worth every dollar of the higher rent honestly
oye cómo vas con lo tuyo últimamente, sigues durmiendo raro?
Sí, sigue siendo medio irregular. Como que me despierto a las 4am a veces y ya no puedo volverme a dormir. Molesta pero nada grave.
¿Y crees que es lo de las pastillas?
Dr. Patel dice que puede ser, que a algunos les pasa. Me dijo que es leve y que el beneficio vale la pena.
oye, ya son dos años en ese apartamento no? tiempo loco
si, dos años exactamente este mes. me mude literalmente la semana que firme los papeles
y mira todo lo que has construido desde entonces parcera 💪
honestly yeah. weird to think about. the apartment is 100% mine now you know
parcera did u see the senate vote on the healthcare bill?? they gutted the public option AGAIN
I literally cannot. We should just do what Canada does, one system for everyone, done
exacto!! my clients at the nonprofit cant afford the premiums AND cant qualify for medi-cal its so broken
The families you work with shouldn't have to choose between rent and seeing a doctor
speaking of rent did u see that chico ballot measure for rent stabilization
Already signed the petition. Building more is good but we need caps NOW while they build
que nota 💪 ok gotta run but love u parcera
Oye, ¿Pixel está bien? La vi en el video de ayer 😍
Pixel está divina como siempre. Siete años ya y sigue siendo la más mandona. Está encima de mi laptop en este momento.
Solo Pixel y yo. Así me gusta. Más privacidad que vivir con alguien.
Mija estaba buscando las fotos de tu abuela bailando cumbia en el Carnaval, las del 87 antes de venir aquí
Omg mamá 😭 she looks so young! Is that Barranquilla?
Sí, en la calle 84 near where abuela grew up. She danced in the comparsa three years before she met abuelo
I remember you telling me about the marimondas chasing her through the crowd when she was little
Ay sí she was terrified of the masks! And then she became one herself 😂
Can you send me more of these? I want to show Valentina
Claro mi amor, I'll look through the box this weekend 💕
Hey so next Saturday we're doing the Upper Park ridge trail — the one with all the creek crossings 🏔️
Might want your Merrells not the Salomons, there's gonna be mud
Good call. I ruined my last pair on that trail in January
Actually need to swing by REI before then, the treads on my hiking boots are basically smooth now
The outlet on Mangrove has a sale rn! Got my Gore-Tex shell there last week 🌲
Perfect timing. Also need new soccer cleats before league starts up again
Lol your gear budget must be wild between the hikes and Hooker Oak
It's either trail shoes or real clothes at this point 😂
How are you doing with the October thing? Still thinking about it?
Less than I was. When it hit I couldn't process that he had moved on that fast — I mean we finalized in 2024 and by October he's married again.
Less than two years after. That's fast.
Yeah. I'm okay now mostly. It just still surprises me when it surfaces.
tu Instagram de arte llego a los 8,400?? que nota prima!!
yes!! 8,400 on the art account. wild. I posted that generative piece last week and it got like 600 saves
you should be charging for prints
working on it lol. the research account is at 1,200 and my personal one is still locked at like 180
who would you say actually shapes how you make work?
James Turrell for installations — the way he makes light a physical space. Kusama for patterns, infinite repetition as something almost meditative
Bjork's soundscapes — I think about them when I'm working on generative pieces, the way texture and pattern interact
and Ted Chiang for how narrative can be a formal structure not just a container
[voice memo 0:55] — parcera escúchame esto que pasó con el abogado
did you vote in the primary?
yes, already sent in my mail-in. I vote in every election — primary, general, midterm, school board, everything
especially school board. those races are where the culture war stuff actually lands. I do my ballot as soon as it comes in
Hey, open enrollment at my job is confusing me. Do you go PPO or HDHP?
PPO all the way. My premium is like $180/month pre-tax but the deductible is $1,500 and I actually use my benefits enough that it makes sense.
Yeah I front-load it in January — put in the max. Glasses and my biweekly copays eat through it fast.
Makes sense. HDHP HSA combo would stress me out with kids anyway.
where do you keep up with the generative art scene? I never know where to look
there's a Discord server I'm in — like 800 people, generative artists. super active. people share work, critique, collab
also the Latinx en IA server for my research network. different vibe but both actually useful
I'll ask the mods for a guest link. the Latinx en IA one is invite-only
Just got out of Roots — that Tuesday teacher subbed in someone new today. My shoulders are going to hate me tomorrow.
Ha, the ambitious substitute. Was it the hot flow one or slow flow?
Very hot. I'm going again Thursday so I better recover fast.
You and your 6:30 AMs. I could never.
Hey so the fundraiser auction is coming together nicely. Your print sold for $180!
How's the cooking going? I'm about to start the dosa batter
ok stirring the sambar now. did you see the Brookings piece on compute concentration?
omg did you see what happened at the county supervisors meeting last night
Ok so Tuesday dinner question — you mentioned wanting to pick my brain about something work-adjacent?
omg the alumni newsletter just came and they featured Dr. Morrison's retirement
Ok the sambar is simmering. What are you making tonight?
Ok I finally started that Capital in the Twenty-First Century book you've been pushing for literal years
Hey did you finish that Vaswani et al follow-up you were telling me about last week?
Okay so I finally started that Piketty book you've been pushing on me for like two years
Ok sambar is simmering. How's your end?
Ok the diffusion architecture notes are fascinating but can I ask you something random
Also — you mentioned something about recurring donations a while back. The org I'm working with does automatic monthly pulls now if you want to set that up
remember when we pulled that all-nighter in Kemper Hall for his algorithms final
How did you get through the first 200 pages? Dense.
Capital and Ideology. I'm only on chapter 3 but I see why you kept annotating your copy
Just got the arepas on the griddle. Also trying to finish up a review I promised someone
yeah I read it this morning. honestly I've been shifting on this stuff
YES I watched the whole livestream, it was infuriating
Yes!! So I've been sketching out this idea for a while now. You know how my diffusion research keeps circling back to audio generation?
Arepas with that aji amarillo pork from mom's peppers
Arepas are resting. I should tell you something though
like two years ago I was mostly worried about capabilities but now I think the real problem is structural
That guy from Paradise who kept interrupting the housing discussion? I was screaming at my laptop
I keep thinking about what it would look like to actually build something. Like, not just publish papers but make tools that producers and composers could actually use
Yum. Also random but I was at drinks with some Berkeley people and ran into Marcus Chen
Oh is that for a journal?
He's still at that trading firm in Chicago. Apex something?
Ohhh you mean like spinning something off eventually?
that was brutal. I was running on coffee and spite
Ha! I remember reading it right after the 2016 election, basically locked myself in my apartment for a week
FINALLY. Wait til you get to the part about property regimes and how they naturalize inequality
My manager asked everyone on the team to name the one thing that drives them. Like for goal-setting. I said 'impact' but it felt wrong coming out of my mouth
the way they just tabled the tenant protections AGAIN
also I had a critique for my ceramics piece the next morning at 8am and showed up looking like a zombie
Oh wow Apex Capital. They recruited hard at Davis senior year
That plus some of the critical race stuff I was reading that semester completely rewired how I think about basically everything
The one from NeurIPS? Yeah finished it Sunday morning with coffee
Changed how I think about basically everything in my research
Daniel's wife is pregnant. Mateo told me yesterday. He saw it on Instagram
No it's for that online network I'm part of. A masters student in Mexico City asked me to look at her diffusion paper before she submits
I'm phone banking Saturday afternoon for the assembly race. The primary's in June and we cannot afford another corporate-backed moderate
That's right you had that offer from them! The one with the insane signing bonus
Their ablation study was interesting but I think they undersold the compute requirements
Oh. How are you sitting with that?
That's really generous of you. You do a lot of those
like right now there's basically what, four companies that can actually train frontier models? maybe five if you count mistral being generous
wait is this for the Chen campaign?

Maybe? I've been reading about Y Combinator's recent batches and there's this whole cohort of creative-AI companies. But I want to do it RIGHT — like actually built by someone who cares about the artist side not just the tech
I still don't know how you juggled both of those worlds. I could barely handle stats + my econ electives
I remember you being very different freshman year tbh. All those Hayek quotes 😂
And thanks but I already have my monthly thing set up through the NorCal one. $75 on the 15th, been doing it since 2023
that consolidation is the problem. we need mechanisms that actually distribute power
Yeah, she's the only one who's actually shown up to community meetings in Butte. Not just parachuting in for photo ops
I love that you're thinking about this seriously. Have you talked to anyone in the space?
Yeah the Chicago quant desk. Sometimes I still think about that fork in the road
God don't remind me. My intro to econ prof had me convinced markets solved everything
I can tell. Your last paper draft had that whole section on wealth concentration in narrative framing
Easy. Wanting to know things I don't know yet
Oh nice, the one Maya was fundraising for last year?
Maybe 3-4 a month? It's nice to pay it forward. Someone did it for me when I was starting out
the printmaking lab was my stress relief honestly. screen printing at 2am kept me sane during senior year
Took some serious reading to undo that. Piketty was the final nail
Lol classic. Can you forward me the PDF? I want to compare their attention head setup to what we're doing at work
Okay we're cooking tomorrow night right? I'll have more thoughts by then

Honestly? I called Valentina last night and cried for like 40 minutes. And then I talked to my mom this morning for an hour. And I feel... okay? Like it's sad but it's not the October remarriage news all over again
It's upstream of literally everything else for me. The teaching, the research, the random Wikipedia spirals at 1am
Different org but same idea. They post updates about who they've helped get home to their families. It's good to see it actually working
so what does that look like concretely
You'd be miserable optimizing millisecond trades and you know it
Yes 7pm. Bring questions. I have SO many post-its in that book
That's actually perfect. I was going to say 'learning' but it sounds corporate
Sent! Also there's a new one on arXiv from last Thursday I bookmarked, DeepMind group on cross-lingual transfer. Adding it to my weekend stack
I'm glad you reached out to people. That's growth, you know. Old you would have spiraled alone for a week
Probably. But $180k starting salary at 22 would have been nice lol
It's why I love having control over my schedule honestly. I can chase whatever thread is pulling me that morning
True. Ok call in 10? I need to flip these
independent auditors with real teeth. not the self-assessment nonsense. actual third parties with subpoena-equivalent access
I donated to her last month! The South Asian orgs down here are all backing her too
Not yet. Still feels like a secret daydream honestly. But I've been saving a little each month into a separate account just in case someday
are you going to the eight year reunion thing they're doing in June?
And you'd be working 90 hour weeks in the Loop instead of doing actual research you care about
I know. I'm actually kind of proud of myself? I wanted to tell you tonight instead of texting because Tuesday dinners are for real stuff
and liability frameworks that make executives personally accountable. not just corporate fines they write off
That's really meaningful. Ok Tuesday still on? I'm making that tomato rasam
good, we need to push the whole slate left, not just settle for whoever the establishment endorses
True. No regrets on picking the PhD path. Usually.
That's exactly what they're for. I love you. Do you need me to come up this weekend?
Ok jealous of the professor life rn. My calendar is 80% meetings I didn't ask for
Yes! I'm doing arepas again, trying a new cheese blend
Your 'weekend stack' 😂 you're the only person I know who has a dedicated reading queue for papers
interesting. what about the open source debate
That's not a daydream, that's a plan with a line item. I'm proud of you. Let's definitely talk more Tuesday
maybe? depends on when exactly. might be in Colombia with abuela
No I think I'm okay. But thank you. I might take you up on it if things shift
Hazard of the job! If I don't keep up I'm useless in lab meeting
I used to be skeptical but now I think it has to be part of the answer. if only 4 companies can build the thing, open weights are one of the only counterweights
hm. let me think on that. sambar is done btw 🍲
Well I'm glad you evolved. Imagine if you'd stayed in that phase
We would NOT be friends lol
how did your February budget look?
ok so the sambar is simmering. what are you making tonight?
arepas with that aji pork!! also have something layered and weird playing in my headphones rn and it's making me want to paint instead of cook
rough lol — came in around $4,100. that tablet blew everything up
lol you always say that about those glitchy electronic albums you love
oof. what's a normal month for you?
it's the one from the late 90s with all the strings that sound like they're breaking apart? idk it does something to my brain
the icelandic one you've played for me like 400 times
usually more like $3,300. last month was just the tablet spike. should be back to normal in March
YES. i swear half my color choices come from whatever that woman was feeling when she made it
your creative process is extremely you
Does your lab cover conferences or do you have to fight for it?
I get $2,000 annual travel budget from the employer. It's earmarked for conferences. Covers flight + hotel for one big one and one smaller one usually.
That's actually really clean. My firm does it case by case and I always have to justify.
Yeah it's one of the perks that makes the state salary more palatable.
Okay stirring the sambar now. How's the arepa dough?
Resting. Should be good in like 10 min
So my coworker Anita was asking about you today. She just finalized hers last month and wanted to know how long it took for you to feel like yourself again
Honestly? The papers being done in '24 helped but it was still like 6 months before the weird phantom limb feeling went away
That's what I told her. That it's not immediate relief like people think
Four years from separated to actually feeling single. Wild math
Anyway I hope she has better twenties than I did lol
She's 34 so hopefully smoother. Okay my sambar is at the temple bell stage 🔔
Hey, got the census follow-up form in the mail today. Apparently they're doing some supplemental survey thing
ok so my coworker keeps forwarding me these podcast clips about vitamin D and immune function
The boxes are still a mess. I always end up checking like three things and writing in the margins
the guy hosting literally says 'I'm just asking questions' at one point
I looked up the actual literature on D supplementation last year when my PCP mentioned it. There's like... one decent meta-analysis and a lot of noise
Oh god same. I do the whole checking two boxes then hovering over the 'some other race' option because none of them actually fit
Like my abuela would be so confused by these categories
right? I tried to explain that to her and she was like 'but this epidemiologist on the show said—'
which epidemiologist though. there's actual practicing ones and then there's the LinkedIn 'thought leader' kind
the second kind. verified checkmark, zero publications since 2018
Right? The South Asian box doesn't capture anything about caste or region. And you're dealing with the whole continent collapse situation
yeah I'd rather just read the CDC summary page and ask Dr. Reyes directly next time I'm in
Exactly. My mom's side is from the mountains, my dad's family is from Cartagena coast. Completely different histories. But I'm supposed to pick ONE thing?
The bureaucratic imagination is so limited
I usually just check the two that feel closest and move on but it always feels incomplete
honestly same. ok sambar lesson still on for Tuesday right? I got the toor dal
did you see the thread on X about the diffusion model drama?
I'm not on X anymore — left like two years ago. the algorithm got unbearable and the paper threads kept turning into pile-ons
oh right I forgot. TikTok then?
nope, deliberately avoiding it. too sticky. I check Instagram maybe 30 min a day and that's it
parcera did you see that ProPublica piece on the Oakland PD budget? I'm so done 🙄
parcera just listened to your voice note from earlier 🙌
so the user study thing, they actually approved recruiting from communities outside the usual pool??
Ugh yes. Every time I think about sending them a tip about that slumlord case, I remember what happened to Maria's brother
FINALLY. took like 4 months of pushing but yes. we're partnering with a community center in Oroville and one in Sacramento that works with Mixteco speakers
getting consent forms translated into Spanish and working on Mixteco audio versions since written isn't always accessible
exacto!! like I'll take my chances with a reporter before I'd call them
esto es HUGE. at my nonprofit we always say the research never reaches the people it claims to be about
At least journalists actually investigate. I sent that tip to the Chronicle last month and someone actually followed up within a week
proud of you for not letting them just do the easy English-only thing 💪
see that's what I'm saying!! meanwhile my clients wait MONTHS for any response from the department
parcera did you see that Oakland city council meeting last night?? they're voting on the crisis response team funding again
parcera did you see what Rubio said about extending the military aid package to Bogotá
I'd rather read a peer-reviewed study on policing outcomes than trust their internal review any day
tbh I had to pull up our own grant language about "centering marginalized voices" in like 3 different meetings before they stopped treating it as a nice-to-have
some people at work are pushing for the full defund thing but idk if the votes are there
like as if the last 25 years haven't been enough 🙄
que nota, the academic in you is showing 😂 pero tienes razón
ugh yes I saw. Another $400M for helicopters and fumigation equipment while actual communities get nothing
we've been doing the same thing since Plan Colombia and it hasn't worked once
I caught the highlights. I think the mobile crisis unit model makes sense - like having actual social workers respond to those 911 calls instead
abuela's neighbor in medellín still can't get clean water but sure let's fund more eradication flights
But I still think you need some kind of armed response for actual violent situations? Like that's just practical
exactly. Every time someone from the State Dept talks about being a 'good partner' I want to scream
yeahhhh I go back and forth. my coworker Daniela is full abolitionist and she makes good points but
a good neighbor doesn't spend decades destabilizing your region and then act surprised when refugees show up
que nota that you're more radical on this than half the people I work with at the nonprofit lol
I think redirecting like 30-40% of budget to trained crisis responders makes more sense than full elimination. The data from Denver's STAR program is actually pretty good
But I get why people want to go further after everything
lol 'radical' — I just think we should stop funding things that don't work and hurt people
que nota the denver thing - sending me the link??
how do you decide who to vote for when you don't know the candidates?
League of Women Voters guide first — really thorough and nonpartisan. then Ballotpedia for the judges and the obscure ones
I have a friend in Sacramento who covers local politics — she texts me when there's something she's been reporting on
for judges specifically I read some of their actual opinions. most people skip that but I think it matters
you research this like a paper 😂
Hey so Priya and I were talking about that whole layoff scare at my company last month
hey so I finally set up that separate Fidelity account like you suggested
Made us realize we should probably have more set aside. How much do you keep liquid for emergencies?
how do you have yours split again? stocks vs bonds?
I've got about 18k in my Marcus high-yield account
oh nice!! mine's like 85/15 right now
Covers roughly 5-6 months if I lost my job or something catastrophic happened
mostly VTSAX and some bond index. keeps it simple

how much you got in there now if you don't mind me asking
Honestly took me forever to build it up but the peace of mind is worth it
around 12k? been putting a little in each month for like 2 years

haha escape hatch from academia or from Chico
both? idk could be startup money could be a down payment someday
Hey so I finally made the appointment
Yeah well you've been on yours for what, three years now? Figured if it helped you through all that stuff with Daniel I should at least try
Started right when everything was falling apart. Best decision I made that whole year

Few weeks for the physical adjustment. Maybe six weeks before I really noticed the difference in how I was handling things
Dr Patel was great about checking in and adjusting
Ok that's reassuring. Priya's been on my case about it since Q4 was so rough
Did you eat today? You were in the zone when I texted at noon.
Toast at 7, coffee. Then I looked up and it was 6pm. I forgot.
Alicia. You cannot run on toast and coffee until 6pm.
I know I know. When I'm really in it the hunger signal just disappears. I'm eating now.
Please set a noon alarm or something.
did you ever get your title changed on the lab website?
yes finally — computer and information research scientist, which is the actual title. the lab page still said 'postdoc' for like 8 months
and you're still at Chico State-affiliated right?
AI lab affiliated with Chico State, yeah. it's complicated but basically I'm research staff. $94k a year which for Chico is actually fine
la huelga de la CSU — te afecta?
not directly — I'm on a research contract, not faculty, so I'm not in the CFA union. but I wish I were
research staff are carved out of the bargaining unit. it's one of those things that feels structurally unfair — we work alongside faculty, same mission, different protections
Mija, ¿cómo te sientes? Mateo me dijo que estabas un poco congestionada.
Mejor. Me hice una aguapanela con limón esta tarde y el arnica en el cuello. Ya me siento más tranquila.
Eso, siempre funciona 💛 Te lo enseñé yo.
Lo sé, ma. Lo tienes grabado en mí.
Saturday hike confirmed — Bidwell upper park, 8am start
I'm in. who else from the club is coming?
me, you, David, and two new members. I'll send the group message
perfect. I've missed the last two — work stuff. glad to be back on the Saturday schedule

I brought you groceries twice that week. You scared me a little honestly.

game night at mine Friday — Wingspan or Terraforming Mars?

perfect. I'll bring the snacks. dibs on the Tharsis Republic again

Sí, cada mañana con el desayuno. No se me olvida.

yes!! so excited for the wildflowers
actually can we push to 8? I need to swing by the optometrist first thing, picking up my new frames finally

LensCrafters on E 20th. They open at 7 so I can grab them and still make it
